mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with slight rain near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is currently in its third quarter phase. The International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 60 degrees, and we are expecting rain overnight.

In city news, Deputy Chief Liz Gay has joined the Verona EMS team. She brings extensive experience from her previous work in South Carolina and the Midwest, and she will be focusing on personnel and organizational development. Also, a reminder that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling, so please remember to keep your carts forward-facing and away from obstructions.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

Looking at the police department's weekly recap, on October 25, officers responded to a report of a vehicle stopped at an intersection where they discovered the driver passed out, resulting in an arrest for O W I.

Today's flavor of the day was Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Since the store is now closed for the night, we look forward to tomorrow's flavor, which will be Turtle Cheesecake. The store will open again tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
